verdict.description: CLEAN only if the diff has no defect you can name concretely.

severity.description: blocking: wrong result or data loss. major: wrong under a realistic input. minor: worth noting, ships without it.

claim.description: The defect, stated as a fact about the code.

why_it_matters.description: What goes wrong for a person or a business.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input or state, and the wrong output it produces.
